phase3_findings.description: Advisory (explicitly NOT a defect in this PR): the frozen-occurrence mechanism in lib/test/lint-brand-devflow-sweep.py freezes every DevFlow on any line containing the entry's context substring; the lint's reverse check catches a stale context (matches nothing) but cannot catch an over-broad context that masks a genuinely renameable occurrence sharing a line with a frozen one. Several added contexts are short. This is a pre-existing design property of the existing lint, not introduced by this PR, and is behavior-inert/cosmetic (a missed rename, never a runtime regression). No new test warranted; recorded for future-reviewer awareness only. Non-verdict-gating.

report:
## Verdict: APPROVE (clean mechanical brand-cased DevFlow→PRFlow prose sweep, Batch 5; no runtime behaviour change; frozen literals preserved and correctly reclassified)

## Issue Compliance
Reviewed against issue #2020: brand-cased `DevFlow`→`PRFlow` prose sweep (Batch 5) — criteria from the caller-supplied issue (`--issue 2020`); scope not-established (`acceptance_criteria_divergence` is not-applicable — no workpad comparison was performed by this fanned-out engine pass). The PR satisfies its specification: ordinary product-name prose is swept to `PRFlow` across `docs/**`, tracked root files (`install.sh`, `CLAUDE.md`, `README.md`), `scripts/**`, and `lib/**` excluding `lib/test/**`; semantically-frozen occurrences are reclassified into `lib/test/brand-devflow-buckets.json` frozen buckets rather than rewritten.

## Verification Checklist Results
23 generated, key claims verified — all pass, 0 failed, 0 inconclusive (verified by orchestrator grep + the dedicated reconciliation lint).
Highest-value confirmations:
- Frozen literals preserved: `SHIM_MARKER='Generated by DevFlow scripts/provision-python3-shim.sh'`; provenance selectors `label:PRFlow,DevFlow`, `PROVENANCE_LABEL_SUPERSEDED='DevFlow'`, jq `any(. == "PRFlow" or . == "DevFlow")`; `plugin_aliases: ["devflow"]`; workflow-flight-recorder `routed_command: /devflow:implement`; dispatch-disposition skip-reason `no DevFlow provenance`; install.sh claude.yml signature grep `review_dedupe:|Light @claude-mention listener for non-implementing`; frozen `DEVFLOW_*` env vars and `devflow_*`/`devflow.yml`/`claude.yml` literals; test-pinned install log strings (`locally modified since DevFlow wrote it`, `carries no DevFlow signature`) kept; capability-profiles `manifest_version: 28` unchanged (readme prose only).
- Reconciliation lint `lib/test/lint-brand-devflow-sweep.py` audited 1145/1145 files and exited 0 — its forward guard would have reddened on any pending_sweep_baseline removal still carrying an uncovered DevFlow occurrence, and its reverse guard on any stale frozen-bucket context; neither fired.
